def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    prio = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    if mask.any():
        multiple = np.round(bins[mask] / item) * item
        prio[mask] = -np.abs(bins[mask] - multiple)
    return prio

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    prio = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    if not np.any(mask):
        return prio
    remaining_capacity = bins[mask] - item
    deviation = np.abs(bins[mask] - 1.5 * item)
    deviation = np.where(deviation == 0, 1e-10, deviation)
    prio[mask] = remaining_capacity / (deviation ** 2)
    return prio

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    import numpy as np
    mask = bins >= item
    prio = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    if not mask.any():
        return prio
    remaining_capacity = bins[mask] - item
    current_utilization = (bins[mask] - remaining_capacity) / bins[mask]
    target_utilization = 0.75
    deviation_from_target = np.abs(current_utilization + item / bins[mask] - target_utilization)
    priority_scores = 1.0 / (1 + deviation_from_target)
    prio[mask] = priority_scores
    return prio
